summary.en: The great Old French prose romance of Lancelot du Lac, the central part of the Lancelot-Grail (Vulgate) Cycle, written by anonymous authors in the early 13th century. It tells of Lancelot's chivalry and his love for Queen Guinevere, and was among the most widely read books of medieval Europe.

en: Part of the Lancelot-Grail or Vulgate Cycle
Anonymous; later manuscripts attribute parts to Walter Map
Galehaut (Galeotto in Italian) acts as go-between for Lancelot and Guinevere
